This class is for you if

You want to understand sleep, not just follow a schedule

  • You’ve read the books and the apps, and want an approach that looks at the whole child.
  • You’d like gentle, responsive ideas that fit your family’s values.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Why sleep is full of clues

The whole-picture way of looking at sleep, and why one-size plans rarely fit every family.

The everyday pieces of the puzzle

How feeding, daytime rhythm, environment and development can all play a part in nights.

What to note down for a week, and how to spot patterns in what you see.

An educational overview of why it comes up, and when to speak to a qualified health professional.

Gentle next steps for your family

How to choose a first step that respects your child, your values and your energy.
